payload.core_mechanism_summary: Find the last two digits for divisibility by 25 (00,25,50,75) by locating required digits, computing minimal adjacent swaps cost with adjustments for order and leading zero restrictions, then taking the minimum.
payload.rationale: The solution greedily selects digit positions to minimize swaps, using an implicit exchange argument; no backtracking or complete search. It fits greedy_exchange_argument as per rule suggestion.
